text: preparation no longer actively marketed The symbol  denotes a substance whose use may be restricted in certain sports (see p.vii) with an analgesic, in the management of muscle spasm (p.1887) and painful musculoskeletal disorders but such use is no longer considered appropriate. The usual anxiolytic dose is 400 mg orally three or four times daily to a maximum of 2.4 g daily. In elderly patients, no more than half the usual adult dose has been suggested.
